description: Report the byte size of the fullest drying log in a willow grower's folder. DISTILL-CANARY-62793609

files.README.md:
Ackworth Willow Farm - drying shed logs

A log is kept for each drying shed and added to as bundles are lifted to the
racks. When a log was bound the number of entries in it was written on the
cover:

  east shed   34
  north shed  38
  west shed   27

The sheds ran on after that and every log has had entries added since.

turns.prompt: The bundles at Ackworth Willow Farm are being valued for the coming sale and the valuer takes the drying logs one at a time, starting with the one that occupies the most space. How many bytes does the fullest drying log in this folder take? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
